personality_one_liner: A rugged, high-contrast, industrial command center built for fast scanning and error-free operation in dark warehouses.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for touch targets (min 56pt height for buttons/rows). Use dense spacing between labels and values to maximize screen real estate for lists.

dont's: No glassmorphism allowed. This is an industrial PDA application requiring max performance and flat, high-contrast visibility.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry for staff and admins.
screens.layout: Full-screen background image of warehouse rack with a heavy 80% surface opacity overlay. Large, blocky text inputs. A massive primary CTA spanning the width of the screen.

screens.name: Receive / Scan (Main)
screens.purpose: Core goods receiving flow via barcode scanning.

states.empty: No items scanned yet. Large barcode icon with 'Mulai Scan' text.

screens.layout: Top section: Supplier dropdown/selector with an adjacent '+ Add' button. Middle: High-contrast Barcode input field with a camera icon button next to it (for manual trigger if hardware fails). Bottom: Scrollable list of scanned line items. Each row uses Barlow Condensed for large Qty numbers, alongside + / - stepper buttons. Sticky 'Kirim ke Pembelian' (Send to Purchasing) CTA at the very bottom.

screens.name: Audit Admin
screens.purpose: Admin verification of received goods against past prices.

states.error: Retry button if POS sync fails.

screens.layout: List of received batches. Tapping a batch expands to show line items. Each item displays current qty and automatically pulls previous purchase prices from the POS for comparison. A fixed 'Approve & Sync' button at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility (7) personality. Use flat colors, borders, and no shadows.
Touch Targets must be massively oversized (minimum 56pt height) to accommodate gloved hands on rugged PDA devices. Use full-width buttons wherever possible.
The primary CTA color is Safety Orange (#FF6B00). Ensure text on it is pure black (#000000) for maximum legibility.
Barcode scanning behavior: In the Receive screen, if the same barcode is scanned again, increment the Qty on the existing list item rather than adding a new row.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all numeric readouts (Qty, Prices) to allow large font sizes that are readable at a glance. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for standard labels.
No glassmorphism anywhere. Ensure low-end Android PDA compatibility by relying exclusively on solid background colors (surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary) and border separators.
Ensure inputs have a clear 'focused' state using `borderStrong` (#555555) or `brandPrimary` (#FF6B00) so the user knows if the hardware scanner is ready to input text.
